agent.cmd: ssh -T -o BatchMode=yes -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=4 host-a .local/bin/acp-tmux -config .config/acp-tmux/config.json -agent fir

server.introduction: acp-tmux — drives real terminal coding agents (codex, claude-code, aider, crush, gemini-cli, opencode) in tmux panes on host-a, fronted as ACP. Turn boundaries via ACPEND markers.
